These inducement RSUs are subject to the terms of Travere’s 2018 Equity Incentive Plan (“2018 Plan”) but were granted outside of the 2018 Plan and were granted as inducements material to the new employees entering into employment with Travere in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). items.title: Mario Larenas Joins Business Advisory Council to Advocate Private-Sector Priorities
items.summary: Mario Larenas Joins Business Advisory Council to Advocate Private-Sector Priorities mboyle Thu, 06/11/2026 - 08:25 Post Image June 11, 2026 - Mario Larenas, Country Manager for Freeport-McMoRan in Chile, has been confirmed as a member of the Business Advisory Council of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation. The Business Advisory Council is the official private-sector body within the broader Asia-Pacific group. It brings together leading business figures from various sectors of the economy to help ensure the perspectives of the private sector are reflected in the larger organization’s agenda and policy discussions. The advisory council’s year-long work will culminate when members present consolidated business recommendations to heads of state and government officials. “From my role as Country Manager for Freeport-McMoRan in Chile, I am honored to represent my country on the APEC Business Advisory Council,” Larenas said. “This role enables the private sector to contribute to advancing trade, investment and sustainable economic growth across the Asia Pacific region.” Photo: Mario Larenas, Country Manager for Freeport-McMoRan in Chile
